title: New blood: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 36

## New blood

**Word Power 36 · English idioms**

### Meaning

New members or employees with a lot of energy or fresh ideas.

### Usage

1. This company has been run in the same way for over twenty years. What it needs is some new blood.

### How to use it

New blood is an uncountable expression for new people bringing fresh energy or ideas to a group. It is not normally pluralised as 'new bloods'. The context makes the figurative meaning clear.

### Another example

The reading club invited new members because its committee needed some new blood.

### Check your understanding

Choose: The team needs ___ new blood. (some / a)

### Suggested answer

Some. In this figurative use, blood is uncountable. Say a new member when referring to one particular person.
